_comment: VISUAL CANON — Garland yn Greenholt (PC). Identity only; rendering is handled by the global house-style block (config/image-prompts/house-style.json). Inject this entity's `appearance` (and `critical_clauses`/`do_not_drift`) into any scene spec that features Garland, so he looks the same across sessions. Validated in the character-consistency spike (M1 judged pass at R1; held in the M3 two-subject and M5 composite seeds with zero attribute bleed). Canon format is structured JSON, locked in M1 (JSON beat prose for per-feature control of eyes/pose).
name: Garland yn Greenholt
validated_seed: image/spike/garland-json-r1.jpg (gitignored spike scratch; M1 judged pass — the realized look this canon reproduces)
derived_from: player reference images (grounded, internally consistent — safe to use as the identity source) + kb/pcs/garland-yn-greenholt.md; validated by spike M1/M3/M5

face: extraordinarily old man, weathered and deeply lined
sun-creased leathery skin, age spots, prominent crow's feet and forehead lines
pale blue-grey eyes, alert and clear
long straight nose, heavy expressive brow
appearance.ears: long, pointed elven ears, clearly visible (Greenholt Bloodline marker — always pointed, never rounded)
hair: shoulder-length, swept back off the face
beard: covers jaw, chin and upper lip
build: tall and rangy, broad-shouldered but lean
sinewy, wiry old-man strength; veined weathered hands
upright posture, vigorous despite centuries of age
bearing of an old soldier — steady, unhurried, sturdy
attire: worn olive/brown wool hooded cloak, draped over one shoulder
round metal disc brooch clasp at the throat
wide brown leather belt with leather straps and pouches
signature_items: weathered leather-bound spellbook, thick and battered, bound with cord/straps (carried in one hand or at the belt; may be absent in a given scene)
greatsword 'Second Harvest' — long double-edged blade, plain straight crossguard, worn grip, sheathed or grounded point-down, never raised (may be absent in a given scene)

critical_clauses.eye_lighting: Garland's deep-set old eyes default into brow shadow, killing the diagnostic pale blue. Put a soft, warm, even frontal fill on the face (head level-to-slightly-raised) so the light falls fully on the eyes and the pale-blue irises read clearly — do NOT demand flat/no-directional light (that backfires; ask positively for soft even overcast fill).

do_not_drift: ears must stay long and pointed (elven) — never rounded
must read as EXTRAORDINARILY OLD and weathered — no youthful vigor, no de-aging
no plate armor — wool cloak + leather only
eyes must be lit and pale-blue/blue-grey readable, not sunk in brow shadow
candid/un-posed — no heroic stance, no raised or brandished weapon, no 'posed studio' frontal key-lit portrait
multi_subject_notes: When Garland shares a frame with another character, place him via a `subjects` array entry with explicit LEFT/RIGHT placement and 'ONLY this figure has pointed ears / a beard / silver hair / no plate' qualifiers, plus a do_not_include line naming the bleed directly. This produced ZERO attribute bleed in the M3 two-shot and M5 composite (no reference image needed).
style_notes: Rendering handled globally by house-style.json; this file is identity only. Garland is the 'grounded/easy' case — no de-gloss fight; player refs are already on-style.
